name: kiwi-tcms-connector
description: Manage Kiwi TCMS test plans, runs and cases from VS Code, map them to your automated tests and execute them without leaving the editor.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Connect to your Kiwi TCMS instance to see test runs and report results from the editor.
[Sign In](command:kiwi.signIn)

Sign in to browse test plans and map test cases to your code.

runToken.description: Internal identifier of a Kiwi TCMS test execution.

kiwi.url.markdownDescription: Base URL of your Kiwi TCMS instance, e.g. `https://tcms.example.com`. Set it with **Kiwi: Sign In**.

kiwi.username.description: Kiwi TCMS username. The password is kept in VS Code's secret storage.

kiwi.allowSelfSignedCertificate.description: Accept self-signed / untrusted TLS certificates (common for self-hosted Kiwi TCMS).

kiwi.product.description: Only show test plans and runs of this product (product name). Leave empty to show all.

enumDescriptions: Only runs that are not finished yet.
All runs (can be slow on large instances).
kiwi.runs.show.description: Which test runs to list in the Test Runs view.

kiwi.runs.limit.description: Maximum number of test runs shown (newest first).

kiwi.mapping.patterns.markdownDescription: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) that find Kiwi test case IDs in your code. The first capture group must contain the ID (or a comma-separated list of IDs). Defaults match `@kiwi(123)`, `@pytest.mark.kiwi(1, 2)`, `# kiwi: 123`, `// kiwi=123` and `TC-123` / `KIWI-123` (tags, test names).

kiwi.mapping.include.description: Glob of files scanned for test case markers.

kiwi.mapping.exclude.description: Glob of files and folders excluded from marker scanning.

kiwi.mapping.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files scanned for markers.

kiwi.mapping.insertTemplates.markdownDescription: Marker text inserted by **Link Test to Existing Test Case** / **Create Test Case from Test**, per VS Code language id. `${id}` is replaced by the case ID. Built-in defaults: `# kiwi: ${id}` (Python, Ruby, shell…), `// kiwi: ${id}` (JS/TS, Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, PHP…), `TC-${id}` as a Robot Framework tag, `@TC-${id}` for Gherkin. Example override: `{ "python": "@pytest.mark.kiwi(${id})" }`. The inserted text must match one of `kiwi.mapping.patterns`.

kiwi.mapping.validate.description: Show a warning in the Problems panel for markers that reference test cases which do not exist in Kiwi TCMS.

kiwi.run.command.markdownDescription:
Shell command that runs **one** test case. Variables: `${caseId}`, `${runId}`, `${executionId}`, `${planId}`, `${buildId}`, `${file}`, `${relativeFile}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasename}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}`, `${line}`, `${testName}`, `${testClass}`, `${pytestNodeId}`, `${summary}`, `${workspaceFolder}`, `${env:NAME}`. Examples:
- custom runner: `python run.py --run-id ${runId} --case-id ${caseId}`
- pytest: `pytest "${pytestNodeId}"`
- Robot Framework: `robot --include TC-${caseId} tests`
- Maven/JUnit: `mvn -q test -Dtest=${testClass}#${testName}`

The environment also gets `KIWI_RUN_ID`, `KIWI_CASE_ID`, `KIWI_CASE_IDS`, `KIWI_EXECUTION_ID`, `TCMS_RUN_ID`, `TCMS_PLAN_ID`, …

kiwi.run.batchCommand.markdownDescription: Optional shell command that runs **several** test cases at once (whole test run / file). Variables: `${caseIds}` (comma separated), `${caseIdsSpace}`, `${files}` (quoted, space separated), `${pytestNodeIds}`, `${runId}`, `${planId}`, `${buildId}`, `${workspaceFolder}`. Example: `python run.py --run-id ${runId} --case-ids ${caseIds}`. When empty, `kiwi.run.command` is executed once per case.

kiwi.run.cwd.description: Working directory for test commands. Supports the same variables as kiwi.run.command.

kiwi.run.env.description: Extra environment variables for test commands. Values support the same variables as kiwi.run.command.

enumDescriptions: Set the execution in the active run to PASSED (exit code 0) or FAILED (non-zero).
Ask which status to report after each single test.
Do not report – your framework reports results to Kiwi itself. The view is refreshed afterwards.
kiwi.run.reportResult.description: How results of tests started from VS Code are reported to the active test run.

kiwi.run.markRunning.description: Set the execution status to RUNNING while the test is executing.

kiwi.run.addComment.description: Add a comment with the exit code to the execution when reporting a result.

kiwi.codeLens.enabled.description: Show Kiwi CodeLens (summary, status, Run / Pass / Fail) above test case markers.

kiwi.newCase.status.description: Status of test cases created from code (e.g. CONFIRMED, PROPOSED).

kiwi.newCase.priority.description: Priority of test cases created from code (e.g. P1). Empty = first priority.

kiwi.newCase.category.description: Category name for test cases created from code. Empty = ask when the product has several categories.
